app.title: Python Workers are now generally available
app.author: torutofu
app.description: Cloudflare Python Workers is a CLI tool for building and deploying serverless Python functions to Cloudflare Workers runtime.
proposed_tests: Install the package via pip and run 'python-workers --help' to verify CLI is accessible
Create a minimal 'hello world' worker script, deploy locally with 'python-workers dev', and ensure response is correct
Measure deployment time for a 1KB worker
Run a unit test to verify the CLI can read environment variables
Compare local dev performance vs. Cloudflare Workers edge execution
